row.evidence: Personio's identity integrations sync only outward (Personio to Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace), and its Entra ID article says the integration 'uses a proprietary sync mechanism — it doesn't use SCIM'; no inbound SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: Status unchanged (none), by absence of any inbound SCIM endpoint: Personio is the HR source of truth and pushes users out to Entra ID, Okta, Google Workspace and Atlassian via Marketplace integrations (proprietary, not SCIM). Plans are now Core and Core Pro (help-centre plan overview), priced by Sales; June's Essential/Professional/Enterprise names and the ~$5-15/employee estimates came from Vendr/ITQlick and are dropped. The pricing page (personio.com/pricing) returned a Vercel checkpoint (HTTP 429), so the help-centre plan overview is used as the pricing source. Core includes Google SSO; Core Pro adds OAuth, the Okta/Entra integrations and the Public API. SAML 2.0 SSO is documented for any IdP (plan not stated). No JIT: employees must be invited first. The Public API v2 (OAuth2 client credentials) creates, updates and deletes Person/Employment records, with person.* webhooks.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Includes Google single sign-on; Public API, OAuth and Okta/Entra integrations are listed as Core Pro additions. Whether SAML SSO is on Core is not stated.

scim.notes: No inbound SCIM endpoint is documented. Personio's identity integrations run outbound only (Personio creates, updates and deactivates users in Entra ID, Okta and Google Workspace) and the Entra integration explicitly does not use SCIM.

auth.notes: Client ID and secret from the API credentials page exchanged for a bearer token valid 24 hours.

capabilities.notes: Persons are employee records (the people who get Personio accounts); the API does not document login/account or role management. Org units (departments, teams) are readable.

endpoints.purpose: List persons (filter by id, first_name, last_name, created_at, updated_at)

rate_limits.text: Authentication endpoint: 150 requests per minute for access tokens, then 1 request per second for 60 seconds.

okta.notes: OIN entry is marked only for Workflow Templates and Workflows Connectors; no SAML or SCIM functionality. Personio's own Okta integration pushes users from Personio to Okta.

entra.notes: No Learn tutorial at /entra/identity/saas-apps/personio-tutorial (404). Personio documents Entra SSO (SAML/OIDC) and an outbound Personio-to-Entra sync.

google.notes: Google SSO via OAuth 2.0; Google Workspace Directory Sync runs Personio to Google.

onelogin.notes: Named as a supported SAML 2.0 IdP.

jumpcloud.notes: Named as a supported SAML 2.0 IdP.

fallbacks.other_sync: Outbound HRIS sync: Personio creates, updates and deactivates users in Entra ID, Okta, Google Workspace and Atlassian (Personio is the source of truth).
